aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex_discover = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_arcane_battery_capital_complex value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_last_discovered value = flag:arcane_battery_capital_complex }
}
aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex_activate = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_activation_counter } } set_variable = { name = aov_inv_activation_counter value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = aov_inv_activation_counter add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_arcane_battery_capital_complex value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_arcane_battery_capital_complex_order value = var:aov_inv_activation_counter }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aov_artificery_dormant } NOT = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex } }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex }
	}
}
aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex_deactivate = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_arcane_battery_capital_complex value = 1 }
	remove_variable = aov_inv_arcane_battery_capital_complex_order
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex } remove_character_modifier = aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex }
}

	remove_variable = aov_inv_damestear_reactor_megacannon_order
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_damestear_reactor_megacannon } remove_character_modifier = aov_invention_damestear_reactor_megacannon }
}

aov_invention_demonflame_flamethrowers_discover = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_demonflame_flamethrowers value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_last_discovered value = flag:demonflame_flamethrowers }
}
aov_invention_demonflame_flamethrowers_activate = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_activation_counter } } set_variable = { name = aov_inv_activation_counter value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = aov_inv_activation_counter add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_demonflame_flamethrowers value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_demonflame_flamethrowers_order value = var:aov_inv_activation_counter }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aov_artificery_dormant } NOT = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_demonflame_flamethrowers } }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_demonflame_flamethrowers }
	}
}
aov_invention_demonflame_flamethrowers_deactivate = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_demonflame_flamethrowers value = 1 }
	remove_variable = aov_inv_demonflame_flamethrowers_order
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_demonflame_flamethrowers } remove_character_modifier = aov_invention_demonflame_flamethrowers }
}

	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_bureaucratizer } remove_character_modifier = aov_invention_bureaucratizer }
}

aov_invention_crierless_crier_device_discover = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_crierless_crier_device value = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_last_discovered value = flag:crierless_crier_device }
}
aov_invention_crierless_crier_device_activate = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_activation_counter } } set_variable = { name = aov_inv_activation_counter value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = aov_inv_activation_counter add = 1 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_crierless_crier_device value = 2 }
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_crierless_crier_device_order value = var:aov_inv_activation_counter }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = aov_artificery_dormant } NOT = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_crierless_crier_device } }
		add_character_modifier = { modifier = aov_invention_crierless_crier_device }
	}
}
aov_invention_crierless_crier_device_deactivate = {
	set_variable = { name = aov_inv_crierless_crier_device value = 1 }
	remove_variable = aov_inv_crierless_crier_device_order
	if = { limit = { has_character_modifier = aov_invention_crierless_crier_device } remove_character_modifier = aov_invention_crierless_crier_device }
}

# Technomancers: roll up to 3 economic offers for this research cycle
aov_inventions_roll_offers_economic = {
	remove_variable = aov_tech_offer_economic_1
	remove_variable = aov_tech_offer_economic_2
	remove_variable = aov_tech_offer_economic_3
	set_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_economic
	if = {
		limit = { aov_inventions_economic_unoffered_discoverable = yes }
		random_list = {
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex_discoverable = yes NOT = { aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex_offered = yes } }
				set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_economic_1 value = flag:arcane_battery_capital_complex }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_automated_translator_discoverable = yes NOT = { aov_invention_automated_translator_offered = yes } }
				set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_economic_1 value = flag:automated_translator }
			}
			1 = {
				trigger = { aov_invention_market_mender_discoverable = yes NOT = { aov_invention_market_mender_offered = yes } }

	}

# Technomancers: discover the chosen target if it is still discoverable
aov_inventions_discover_research_target = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:arcane_battery_capital_complex aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:automated_translator aov_invention_automated_translator_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_automated_translator_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:market_mender aov_invention_market_mender_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_market_mender_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:plane_of_water_teleporter aov_invention_plane_of_water_teleporter_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_plane_of_water_teleporter_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:self_cleaning_parchment aov_invention_self_cleaning_parchment_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_self_cleaning_parchment_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:spell_in_a_box aov_invention_spell_in_a_box_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_spell_in_a_box_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:brass_prosthesis aov_invention_brass_prosthesis_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_brass_prosthesis_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:chi_cultivation aov_invention_chi_cultivation_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_chi_cultivation_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:gene_food_cultivation aov_invention_gene_food_cultivation_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_gene_food_cultivation_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:growth_beans aov_invention_growth_beans_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_growth_beans_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:subterrenes aov_invention_subterrenes_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_subterrenes_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:vendorless_stall aov_invention_vendorless_stall_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_vendorless_stall_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:elemental_locomotives aov_invention_elemental_locomotives_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_elemental_locomotives_discover = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:aov_research_target = flag:pathway_transmutation aov_invention_pathway_transmutation_discoverable = yes }
		aov_invention_pathway_transmutation_discover = yes
	}

		aov_invention_mirage_detector_3000_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:remedial_tinctures aov_invention_remedial_tinctures_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_remedial_tinctures_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:think_thought_transmitters aov_invention_think_thought_transmitters_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_think_thought_transmitters_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:bureaucratizer aov_invention_bureaucratizer_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_bureaucratizer_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:crierless_crier_device aov_invention_crierless_crier_device_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_crierless_crier_device_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:negotiation_nexus aov_invention_negotiation_nexus_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_negotiation_nexus_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { has_variable = aov_last_discovered var:aov_last_discovered = flag:runethought_network aov_invention_runethought_network_activatable = yes }
		aov_invention_runethought_network_activate = yes
	}
}

# Over the slot maximum: deactivate the most recently activated invention (no cooldown)
aov_inventions_deactivate_newest = {
	if = {
		limit = { aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex_active = yes has_variable = aov_inv_arcane_battery_capital_complex_order var:aov_inv_arcane_battery_capital_complex_order = aov_invention_newest_order }
		aov_invention_arcane_battery_capital_complex_deactivate = yes

		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_inv_negotiation_nexus } NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_negotiation_nexus } }
		set_variable = { name = aov_inv_negotiation_nexus value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { aov_invention_runethought_network_active = yes } NOT = { aov_invention_runethought_network_active = yes } }
		aov_invention_runethought_network_activate = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_inv_runethought_network } NOT = { has_variable = aov_inv_runethought_network } }
		set_variable = { name = aov_inv_runethought_network value = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_economic } NOT = { has_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_economic } }
		set_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_economic
		if = { limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_economic_1 } } set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_economic_1 value = scope:aov_predecessor.var:aov_tech_offer_economic_1 } }
		if = { limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_economic_2 } } set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_economic_2 value = scope:aov_predecessor.var:aov_tech_offer_economic_2 } }
		if = { limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_economic_3 } } set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_economic_3 value = scope:aov_predecessor.var:aov_tech_offer_economic_3 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_military } NOT = { has_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_military } }
		set_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_military
		if = { limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_military_1 } } set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_military_1 value = scope:aov_predecessor.var:aov_tech_offer_military_1 } }
		if = { limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_military_2 } } set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_military_2 value = scope:aov_predecessor.var:aov_tech_offer_military_2 } }
		if = { limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_military_3 } } set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_military_3 value = scope:aov_predecessor.var:aov_tech_offer_military_3 } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_society } NOT = { has_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_society } }
		set_variable = aov_tech_offers_rolled_society
		if = { limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_society_1 } } set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_society_1 value = scope:aov_predecessor.var:aov_tech_offer_society_1 } }
		if = { limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_society_2 } } set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_society_2 value = scope:aov_predecessor.var:aov_tech_offer_society_2 } }
		if = { limit = { scope:aov_predecessor = { has_variable = aov_tech_offer_society_3 } } set_variable = { name = aov_tech_offer_society_3 value = scope:aov_predecessor.var:aov_tech_offer_society_3 } }
	}
}

# AI: activate the highest-tier discovered invention
aov_inventions_ai_activate_best = {
	if = {
		limit = { aov_inventions_t3_activatable = yes }
		aov_inventions_ai_activate_tier_3 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { aov_inventions_t2_activatable = yes }
		aov_inventions_ai_activate_tier_2 = yes
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { aov_inventions_t1_activatable = yes }
		aov_inventions_ai_activate_tier_1 = yes
	}
}
